scoring_policy.detail: Each of the 23 protocol criteria has equal weight. An accepted criterion counts 1; a reviewed but not fully accepted criterion counts only its independently verified partial gates as completed/N, never a full point until all required acceptance evidence exists. Unreviewed criteria receive no presumed progress. The result is ONE percentage for implementation tracking.
scoring_policy.no_double_count: An officially accepted item must not appear under reviewed_partial_gates. One evidence must not be scored twice.
scoring_policy.completion_rule: 100% only when all 23 official criteria have formal acceptance; production readiness also requires final rollout authorization.
scoring_policy.caveat: This is an evidence-based tracking number, not an effort estimate, elapsed-time measure or proof of real device, full backup or provider behavior absent its specific test. The acceptance checklist remains an internal nonpercentage audit record.
